text:
Jordan (ML): quick sync — after the q2-int8 bring-up we started seeing a recurring failure mode on multi-turn prompts (long system + user history). looks like lexical drift + duplicate ingest noise is amplifying quantization regressions. Need a small, high-signal "microgolden" and a curation pass to triage.
Maya K: +1. I flagged a sample set where EM dropped ~12%. suspect dedupe missed near-duplicates with HTML escapes.
Samir: could be tokenizer-normalization mismatch + fuzzyhash threshold. propose: run a length-stratified sample and fuzzyhash dedupe at sim>=0.88. example SQL to pull candidates: 
```sql
select id, text, length(text) as toks from prompt_ingest where created_at > '2025-10-01' order by random() limit 20000;
```
then run `fuzzyhash --threshold 0.88` to collapse.
Liam (Infra): ops note — last quant bench run completed by the deploy-bot at 16:02, I'll requeue with new microgolden once it's ready. how urgent is this?
Jordan (ML): urgent for this week's canary. goal: 200 examples microgolden (balanced by tokens: short/medium/long), labelled pass/fail + severity (1-3) + canonical answer when applicable. run bench vs q2-int8, q8, fp16.
Anita: I can own the microgolden labeling (200 examples). where do you want the CSV and schema?
Jordan (ML): perfect — store in repo: `/datasets/microgoldens/lexical-drift-2026.csv`. schema: `id,text,token_count,label,severity,canonical,notes,tags`. label values: PASS/FAIL. tags: e.g. kvcache, html-escape, dup-origin.
Maya K: request: add `kvcache=true/false` for examples where long prefix likely hits KV cache boundaries. that seems correlated with regression.
Samir: will produce deduped candidate set and split by token_length buckets. plan: run dedupe -> sample 80/80/40 short/med/long -> deliver CSV to Anita by EOD.
Liam (Infra): adding quant variants to bench job: `--models q2-int8,q8,fp16 --batch-sizes 1,4 --seed 42`. reminder: set `--disable-auto-batch` for longctx comparison.
Jordan (ML): small eval snippet from last run for context: 
```
model: q2-int8 | EM: 72.1 | BLEU: 18.3
model: fp16   | EM: 84.2 | BLEU: 25.7
regression concentrated on examples > 512 tokens
```
Anita: noted. I'll start labeling tomorrow morning, will surface ambiguous cases as a triage thread.
OpsBot: pipeline `curation/dedupe/2026-03-21` started by Samir at 18:07 UTC — 12k candidates ingested.
Jordan (ML): owners + action items: Samir -> produce deduped candidate CSV (by token bucket). Anita -> label microgolden (200 rows) and add canonical answers. Liam -> add quant variants and run bench on canary infra. Maya -> add kvcache tags and run HTML-normalizer pass. I'll coordinate eval comparison and patch quant config suggestions.
Samir: noted, ETA EOD. will include `source_channel` column so we can trace duplicates back to origins.
Maya K: FYI I'll push a tiny normalizer: `python -m ingest.normalize_html --in raw.jsonl --out normalized.jsonl --strip_entities`. should reduce false dupes.
Jordan (ML): great. once microgolden is labeled we'll run `run_eval --gold /datasets/microgoldens/lexical-drift-2026.csv --models q2-int8,q8,fp16 --out /runs/lexical-drift-2026/results.json` and open a quick regression PR if EM drop > 5pts on long bucket.
Liam (Infra): I'll schedule the run after Samir posts the deduped CSV. expect ~45m per variant.
Anita: assigning myself in tracker: ML-2483. I'll ping here with interim stats.
Jordan (ML): thanks all — quick sticky: keep messages short in this thread; open separate threads for labeling questions. :thumbsup:
